violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the back room was blocked by stacks of beverages. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC made space to wash hands. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

Milk and hotdogs were observed held at 46 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per interview with PIC, walk-in cooler was turned off due to putting away delivery. PIC turned on walk-in cooler during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026
Walk-in refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

The floors in the walk-in cooler and the floor drain under 3 bay sink have an accumulation of soil residue, litter, and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

The hand-washing sinks are lacking proper signage. A sign or poster reminding food employees to wash their hands must be posted at all hand-washing sinks used by food employees. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2024
A pail was observed in the hand-washing sink in the 3 bay sink area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2024

Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2024
Food observed stored in a toilet room. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2024

Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils are stored on a cluttered and unclean sideboard of the 3 bay sink. Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils must be stored in a clean, dry location, where they are not subject to dust, splash, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2024

The area with the 3 bay sink, and one toilet room have an accumulation of soil residue and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/24/2024
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the establishment. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2024
